senses.gloss:
पौतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, connected with a boat (as
a cargo &c.).

पौतन पौतन (perhaps fr. पूतना), N. of
a country or people.

पौतव पौतव, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
पू), a measure; (also spelt यौतव.)

पौतिकी पौतिकी, f. = पूतिका, a kind of
vegetable.

पौतिनासिक्य पौतिनासिक्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूति-
नासिका), fetor of the nostrils.

पौतिमाषीपुत्र पौतिमाषी-पुत्र, अस्, m.,
Ved., N. of a teacher.

पौतिमाष्य, अस्, m., Ved. (a patronymic fr.
पूति-माष), N. of a teacher.

पौतिमाष्यायण, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic
from Pautimāṣya.

पौत्र 1. पौत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र), de-
rived from a son or from children, belonging or
relating to a son or to children; (अस्), m. a son's
son, grandson; (ई), f. a granddaughter (either in the
male or female line, though more usually implying
a son's daughter); an epithet of Durgā.

पौत्र 2. पौत्र, अम्, n. (fr. पोतृ, q. v.),
Ved. the office of the Potṛ.

पौत्रजीविक, अम्, n. (fr. पुत्र-जीव), an amulet
made of the nuts of the tree Putranjiva Roxburghii.

पौत्राघ (˚र-अघ˚), अम्, n., Ved. any injury
or evil happening to children.

पौत्राद्य, perhaps a wrong reading for the pre-
ceding.
पौत्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pautra.

पौत्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र or 1. पौत्र),
belonging to a son or grandson; (अस्), m. the son
of a Putrikā (?); a patronymic from Putrika (?).

पौत्रिकेय, अस्, m. (fr. पुत्रिका), the son of a
daughter appointed to raise issue for her father.
—पौत्रिकेय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having for a grand-
son the son of a daughter appointed to raise issue.
पौत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. 1. पौत्र), having a grandson.
